governance(pjm): keeper DEMOTED pjm-95 -> pjm-94 — own-fleet probe refutes the temp-derate slopes (rule 24)

The pjm-95 promotion carried an open_validation debt: port the ERCOT
temp-derate closure test to PJM's own fleet; "if PJM's fleet refutes the
slopes the same way, this mechanism exits the keeper the same way ERCOT's
did." It does. scripts/probes/_pjm_temp_capability_envelope.py (PJM CAMPD
unit gross load x zone TMAX, class/zone map from the model's own fleet
build, dominant-group >=90% purity guard; 2023-2025):

- Envelope FLAT: p98 output/reference 0.98-1.11x in every TMAX bin up to
  36-40C for CC_REGULAR/CT_PEAKER/ST_GAS/CC_CHP, all three years, where the
  raw literature curves predict 0.84-0.95.
- Lower bound (production <= capability, assumption-free): CC_REGULAR
  median max-output/net-summer 1.00 at TMAX>=34C, 78-89% of capacity proven
  >=0.95x — the fleet demonstrates its rating on the exact hours the derate
  cuts it.
- Max-incentive scarcity-hour slopes (RT>$200: 5,147 plant-hours; RT>$100:
  25,093): CC_REGULAR -0.10/-0.15 %/degC vs model -0.76; CT_PEAKER
  +0.16/+0.27 vs -1.26; CC_CHP +0.58 vs -0.76. Only ST_GAS reads near-model
  (-0.67 vs -0.54, <2%-of-load class, envelope nonetheless flat).

Phase-2 scarcity-structure gap.
